rca of the issue: Original bug: routes/queue.py bulk_action shelled out to `exim -Mrm <mid>` when _has_exim()=True. Preview container has /usr/sbin/exim installed but no spool matching synthetic mids like '1tXXX-...' → exim returned non-zero → nothing deleted → but UI shown success (frontend didn't check per-item ok). Fix (verified): bulk_action ALWAYS operates on mail_events by matching {id: mid} OR {exim_mid: mid} with tenant scope; USE_REAL_EXIM=1 env additionally invokes exim. _mock_queue now uses mail_events.id (or exim_mid if set) as mid so bulk delete matches by id. Frontend toast now correctly separates success/failure via data.failed count.
